# Compute an optional switch input before the switch when it clarifies API aliases

D211861 reviewer questioned switch(viewType || groupType). The author explained V2 viewType and V3 groupType are mutually exclusive in schema, then landed const type = viewType || groupType; switch(type) to make the branch input clear. Current code keeps that local shape. For similar versioned aliases, make the chosen value explicit before a switch when that improves reading; this is supported review guidance, not a blanket syntax ban on expressions in switch.

Scope: WebExtension mail tab syntax.

Paths:

- `mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-mailTabs.js`
- `mail/components/extensions/schemas/mailTabs.json`
